pairs: Fecerunt autem filii Israël malum in conspectu Domini:
Then the sons of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord,
qui tradidit illos in manu Madian septem annis,
who delivered them into the hand of Midian for seven years.
et oppressi sunt valde ab eis.
And they were greatly oppressed by them.
Feceruntque sibi antra et speluncas in montibus,
And they made for themselves hollows and caves in the mountains,
and very fortified places for defense.
and the rest of the eastern nations ascended,
and pitching their tents among them,
sicut erant in herbis cuncta vastabant usque ad introitum Gazæ:
they laid waste to all that was planted, as far as the entrance to Gaza.
nihilque omnino ad vitam pertinens relinquebant in Israël,
And they left behind nothing at all to sustain life in Israel,
Ipsi enim et universi greges eorum veniebant cum tabernaculis suis,
For they and all their flocks arrived with their tents,
and they filled all places like locusts,
an innumerable multitude of men and camels,
Humiliatusque est Israël valde in conspectu Madian.
And Israel was humbled greatly in the sight of Midian.
Et clamavit ad Dominum postulans auxilium contra Madianitas.
And he cried out to the Lord, requesting assistance against the Midianites.
Qui misit ad eos virum prophetam, et locutus est:
And he sent to them a man who was a prophet, and he said:
“Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel:
Ego vos feci conscendere de Ægypto, et eduxi vos de domo servitutis,
‘I caused you to ascend from Egypt, and I led you away from the house of servitude.
And I freed you from the hand of the Egyptians
et omnium inimicorum qui affligebant vos:
and from all of the enemies who were afflicting you.
And I cast them out at your arrival,
and I delivered their land to you.
I am the Lord your God.
You shall not fear the gods of the Amorites,
But you were not willing to listen to my voice.’”
Then an Angel of the Lord arrived,
and he sat under an oak tree,
et pertinebat ad Joas patrem familiæ Ezri.
the father of the family of Ezri.
And while his son Gideon was threshing and cleaning the grain at the winepress,
so that he might flee from Midian,
the Angel of the Lord appeared to him,
if the Lord is with us,
why have these things happened to us?
quæ narraverunt patres nostri, atque dixerunt:
which our fathers described when they said,
‘The Lord led us away from Egypt.’
nunc autem dereliquit nos Dominus, et tradidit in manu Madian.
But now the Lord has forsaken us, and he has delivered us into the hand of Midian.”
And the Lord looked down upon him,
et liberabis Israël de manu Madian:
and you shall free Israel from the hand of Midian.
Know that I have sent you.”
mi domine, in quo liberabo Israël?
my lord, with what shall I free Israel?
ecce familia mea infima est in Manasse,
Behold, my family is the weakest in Manasseh,
et ego minimus in domo patris mei.
and I am the least in the house of my father.”
And the Lord said to him:
et percuties Madian quasi unum virum.
And so, you shall cut down Midian as if one man.”
Si inveni, inquit, gratiam coram te,
“If I have found grace before you,
da mihi signum quod tu sis qui loqueris ad me:
give me a sign that it is you who is speaking to me.
And may you not withdraw from here,
et de farinæ modio azymos panes:
and he made unleavened bread from a measure of flour.
And setting the flesh in a basket,
et jus carnium mittens in ollam,
and putting the broth of the flesh in a pot,
he took it all under the oak tree,
and he offered it to him.
And the Angel of the Lord said to him,
“Take the flesh and the unleavened bread,
and place them on that rock,
and pour out the broth upon it.”
And when he had done so,
the Angel of the Lord extended the end of a staff,
which he was holding in his hand,
et tetigit carnes et panes azymos:
and he touched the flesh and the unleavened loaves.
And a fire ascended from the rock,
and it consumed the flesh and the unleavened loaves.
angelus autem Domini evanuit ex oculis ejus.
Then the Angel of the Lord vanished from his sight.
Vidensque Gedeon quod esset angelus Domini,
And Gideon, realizing that it had been the Angel of the Lord,
quia vidi angelum Domini facie ad faciem.
For I have seen the Angel of the Lord face to face.”
And the Lord said to him:
Ædificavit ergo ibi Gedeon altare Domino,
Therefore, Gideon built an altar to the Lord there,
Domini pax, usque in præsentem diem.
the Peace of the Lord, even to the present day.
And while he was still at Ophrah,
which is of the family of Ezri,
nocte illa dixit Dominus ad eum:
that night, the Lord said to him:
et alterum taurum annorum septem, destruesque aram Baal,
and another bull of seven years, and you shall destroy the altar of Baal,
et nemus, quod circa aram est, succide.
And you shall cut down the sacred grove which is around the altar.
Et ædificabis altare Domino Deo tuo in summitate petræ hujus,
And you shall build an altar to the Lord your God, at the summit of this rock,
on which you placed the sacrifice before.
And you shall take the second bull,
et offeres holocaustum super struem lignorum,
and you shall offer a holocaust upon a pile of the wood,
which you shall cut down from the grove.”
Assumptis ergo Gedeon decem viris de servis suis,
Therefore, Gideon, taking ten men from his servants,
did just as the Lord had instructed him.
and the men of that city,
he was not willing to do it by day. Instead,
Cumque surrexissent viri oppidi ejus mane,
And when the men of that town had risen up in the morning,
they saw the altar of Baal destroyed,
and the sacred grove cut down,
et taurum alterum impositum super altare,
and the second bull set upon the altar,
And they said one to another,
Cumque perquirerent auctorem facti, dictum est:
And when they inquired everywhere as to the author of the deed, it was said,
Gedeon filius Joas fecit hæc omnia.
“Gideon, the son of Joash, did all these things.”
For he has destroyed the altar of Baal,
and he has cut down the sacred grove.”
“Could you be the avengers of Baal,
ut pugnetis pro eo? qui adversarius est ejus,
so that you fight on his behalf? Whoever is his adversary,
let him die before the light arrives tomorrow;
vindicet se de eo, qui suffodit aram ejus.
let him vindicate himself against him who has overturned his altar.”
Ex illo die vocatus est Gedeon Jerobaal,
“Let Baal avenge himself against him who has overturned his altar.”
and the eastern peoples were gathered together.
they encamped in the valley of Jezreel.
But the Spirit of the Lord entered Gideon, who,
qui clangens buccina convocavit domum Abiezer, ut sequeretur se.
sounding the trumpet, summoned the house of Abiezer so that he might follow him.
And he sent messengers into all of Manasseh,
qui et ipse secutus est eum:
et alios nuntios in Aser et Zabulon et Nephthali,
and other messengers into Asher, and Zebulun, and Naphtali,
Si salvum facis per manum meam Israël,
“If you will save Israel by my hand,
ponam hoc vellus lanæ in area:
I will set this wool fleece on the threshing floor.
si ros in solo vellere fuerit,
If there will be dew only on the fleece,
and all the ground is dry,
I will know that by my hand,
Et de nocte consurgens expresso vellere,
And rising in the night, wringing out the fleece,
he filled a vessel with the dew.
And again he said to God:
Ne irascatur furor tuus contra me si adhuc semel tentavero,
“Let not your fury be enkindled against me, if I test once more,
seeking a sign in the fleece.
Oro ut solum vellus siccum sit,
I pray that only the fleece may be dry,
and all the ground may be wet with dew.”
Fecitque Deus nocte illa ut postulaverat:
And that night, God did as he had requested.
et fuit siccitas in solo vellere, et ros in omni terra.
And it was dry only on the fleece, and there was dew on all the ground.
